name: philosophy-feature-extraction-registry
purpose: Turns the user's durable operating philosophy into auditable feature candidates, smallest useful assets, implementation targets, validation gates, rollback plans, and high-quality data records.

reader_guide.summary: Use this registry when the platform should derive product or agent-building features from the user's philosophy instead of treating philosophy as static prose.
how_to_read: Read required_principle_ids to see the full philosophy set that must feed the feature pipeline.
Read feature_intake_stages to see how a principle becomes a feature candidate.
Read principle_feature_flows to see how principle clusters generate different kinds of platform features.
Read seed_feature_candidates to see current implemented, planned, and queued philosophy-derived capabilities.
Run check-philosophy-features after changing this registry, philosophy traceability, capability promotion rules, or the monitor surface.
update_triggers: A philosophy principle is added, removed, or reworded.
A recurring user value or operating principle should become a product capability.
A capability promotion candidate should cite source philosophy principles.
The desktop monitor starts showing or hiding philosophy-derived feature candidates.
Validation, rollback, or high-quality data requirements for feature candidates change.

reference_links.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook
used_for: stakeholder expectation to requirement to verification trace

reference_links.title: US Web Design System Design Principles
used_for: using explicit principles to guide product design decisions

structure_rules.rule: Every id in required_principle_ids must appear in at least one principle_feature_flows.principle_ids entry.
structure_rules.reason: A principle cannot shape platform features if no flow consumes it.

structure_rules.rule: Every feature candidate must include source principles, human process step, hypothesis, smallest asset type, evidence inputs, risk tier, validation targets, and rollback plan.
structure_rules.reason: Philosophy-derived features should remain auditable and reversible instead of becoming vague product ideas.

structure_rules.rule: Candidates with status implemented or active must point to real repository paths.
structure_rules.reason: The registry should distinguish shipped structure from planned capability.

structure_rules.rule: Candidates must prefer prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, then project_feature in that order unless the rejected lighter option is recorded.
structure_rules.reason: The user's philosophy values capability promotion without overbuilding.

structure_rules.rule: Feature extraction must save source, assumption, decision, validation, rollback, and residual-risk data before a candidate becomes active.
structure_rules.reason: The platform should accumulate high-quality data, not just more ideas.

field_guide.meaning: Complete set of durable philosophy principle ids that must feed feature extraction.
Ordered stages that transform source philosophy into feature candidates and validation records.
Principle clusters and the feature questions they generate.
Required fields and allowed asset types for any philosophy-derived feature candidate.
Checks that stop vague, ungrounded, unsafe, or overbuilt candidates.
Current implemented, planned, queued, deferred, or rejected feature candidates derived from philosophy.

feature_intake_stages.label: Philosophy Intake
feature_intake_stages.input: _philosophy source text and the user request
feature_intake_stages.output: principle ids, changed values, and affected product surfaces
checks: private or sensitive material is excluded

feature_intake_stages.label: Principle Clustering
feature_intake_stages.input: principle ids and current traceability registry
feature_intake_stages.output: feature flow lane and affected capability class
checks: every required principle has at least one flow

feature_intake_stages.label: Human Process Model
feature_intake_stages.input: principle cluster and observed work signals
feature_intake_stages.output: competent human work sequence and judgment checkpoints
checks: goal, context, sources, options, decision, verification, handoff, and review are covered

feature_intake_stages.label: Feature Candidate Generation
feature_intake_stages.input: human process model and existing platform assets
feature_intake_stages.output: multiple candidate feature ideas with lighter alternatives
checks: do-nothing or defer option included when evidence is weak

feature_intake_stages.label: Idea Evaluation
feature_intake_stages.output: scored selected, rejected, queued, or deferred candidate
checks: repetition reduction, time savings, evidence, risk, maintenance, and smallest-asset fit are scored

feature_intake_stages.label: Asset Selection
feature_intake_stages.output: prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, or project feature target

feature_intake_stages.label: Implementation Trace
feature_intake_stages.output: files changed, ownership, and rollback plan
checks: rollback or disablement path is concrete

feature_intake_stages.label: Validation And Rework
feature_intake_stages.output: validation result, evaluator result, and residual risks
checks: config, test, UI, and philosophy trace checks run where relevant

feature_intake_stages.label: Data Accumulation
feature_intake_stages.output: history, feature candidate, evidence, timing, and evaluation records
checks: source, assumptions, decisions, validation, and residual risks are recorded
records are usable by the next agent

principle_feature_flows.label: Evidence And Judgment Loop
principle_feature_flows.feature_question: What product capability prevents guesses, weak sources, missing plans, unsupported claims, or unreviewed output from becoming final work?
candidate_rules: Create evidence capture, research synthesis, grounding, evaluator, or rework-loop assets before new presentation features.
Prefer deterministic checks when the principle can be validated mechanically.

principle_feature_flows.label: Capability Factory Loop
principle_feature_flows.feature_question: What repeated human work can be structured into the smallest reusable asset while preserving provenance and validation?
candidate_rules: Model the direct human process before generating feature ideas.
Select prompt, workflow, template, tool, skill, agent, then project feature in that order.
Record structured data quality before using a candidate as evidence.

principle_feature_flows.label: Boundary And Authority Loop
principle_feature_flows.feature_question: What product capability keeps autonomy bounded, records usable, privacy protected, and owner decisions visible?
candidate_rules: Add boundary, view-mode, decision inbox, guardrail, rollback, cost, or privacy capabilities before broad automation.
Do not rely on client-side hiding or prompt-only prohibitions for sensitive or irreversible work.

human_checkpoint_required_when: candidate touches secrets, permissions, installs, public release, security/privacy, or irreversible migration
candidate changes user-facing product direction or owner accountability

quality_gates.rule: A candidate without source_principle_ids cannot be promoted.
quality_gates.failure_action: Return to philosophy_intake and select the source principle ids.

quality_gates.rule: A candidate must describe the competent human process step it reduces or improves.
quality_gates.failure_action: Return to human_process_model and write the direct work sequence.

quality_gates.rule: A candidate must justify why a lighter asset type is insufficient before becoming an agent or project feature.
quality_gates.failure_action: Re-score against smallest_asset_fit and queue heavier work if needed.

quality_gates.rule: A candidate cannot become active without validation targets and rollback or disablement plan.
quality_gates.failure_action: Keep the candidate planned or blocked until validation and rollback are concrete.

quality_gates.rule: Candidate records must preserve source, assumptions, decision, validation, uncertainty, and residual risk.
quality_gates.failure_action: Create or update history, trace, evaluation, or feature-candidate records before close-out.

seed_feature_candidates.label: Philosophy Feature Factory
seed_feature_candidates.human_process_step: A human rereads the user's principles, clusters them into product questions, checks existing assets, drafts several features, selects the smallest asset, then records validation and rollback.
seed_feature_candidates.feature_hypothesis: A registry, checker, workflow, prompt, agent spec, and monitor panel will make philosophy-derived feature generation explicit and repeatable.

validation_targets.validates: Philosophy-derived feature extraction registry remains complete and mechanically checkable.
Agent platform governance tests remain green.

validation_targets.command: npm --prefix workspace-monitor run check && npm --prefix workspace-monitor test
validation_targets.validates: Monitor snapshot and UI type contracts still expose the philosophy feature factory.

seed_feature_candidates.rollback_plan: Remove the registry, checker command, monitor panel, prompt, workflow, and agent spec; then remove the philosophy traceability and memory bootstrap references.

seed_feature_candidates.label: Philosophy Candidate Inbox
seed_feature_candidates.human_process_step: A human keeps feature ideas visible, waits for owner arbitration when values conflict, and separates safe drafts from blocked decisions.
seed_feature_candidates.feature_hypothesis: A persistent candidate inbox can show philosophy-derived feature proposals with status, owner decision needs, and resume actions.

validation_targets.validates: Candidate decisions and blocked work are not silently skipped.

seed_feature_candidates.rollback_plan: Archive the candidate inbox and keep only this registry as the source of planned philosophy-derived features.

seed_feature_candidates.label: Principle To Spec Template
seed_feature_candidates.human_process_step: A human turns a value into acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, implementation plan, traceability, validation, and rework criteria.
seed_feature_candidates.feature_hypothesis: A template can reduce gaps when a philosophy point should become requirements and specs.

validation_targets.validates: Template path and project boundaries remain valid.

seed_feature_candidates.rollback_plan: Remove the template folder and keep the workflow-only route.

seed_feature_candidates.label: Philosophy Gate In Work Evaluator
seed_feature_candidates.human_process_step: A reviewer checks whether the completed work actually reflects the source principles it claims to implement.
seed_feature_candidates.feature_hypothesis: The work evaluator can require philosophy_feature_targets when a task changes platform direction or durable operating behavior.

validation_targets.validates: Evaluation fails when required philosophy feature targets are missing.

seed_feature_candidates.rollback_plan: Remove the evaluator field requirement and keep philosophy feature checks as a separate close-out command.

seed_feature_candidates.label: Data Quality Signal Dashboard
seed_feature_candidates.human_process_step: A human scans accumulated records for provenance, freshness, validation, contradiction, and usefulness before reusing them.
seed_feature_candidates.feature_hypothesis: The monitor can show data-quality signals so stored knowledge is treated as reusable only when provenance and validation are visible.

validation_targets.command: npm --prefix workspace-monitor run check && npm --prefix workspace-monitor test
validation_targets.validates: Dashboard signals remain type-safe and snapshot-backed.

seed_feature_candidates.rollback_plan: Hide the dashboard section and keep data-quality checks as CLI/report-only workflow.
